messages:
alex: proposing we add 'integration' gates to the model onboarding pipeline. Not just bench numbers — fail fast on runtime incompat, API schema, and end-to-end perf regressions. WDYT?

maria: +1. can we make the perf gate relative to a pinned baseline model per-family? absolute numbers vary a lot across sizes.

devin: agree. also need a runtime compatibility matrix: python deps, onnx/torchscript ops, quantized kernels. we get weird OOMs otherwise.

cheng: add eval subset + token-accurate regression tests. e.g., ensure logits for canonical prompts don't shift more than X KL.

alex: proposal: gates = [artifact-schema, ops-compat, smoke-infer (1 request), perf-bench (p95/throughput), quality-regressions(bleu/kl)].

maria: how do we enforce quantization policy? some teams want int8, others float16.

devin: we can tag model artifacts with allowed quant formats. onboarding script runs conversion+sanity tests. fail if conversion changes shape or produces NaNs.

cheng: also add 'canary' rollout for first 1% traffic for 24h with auto-rollback on error rate or latency spike. telemetry triggers need thresholds.

alex: sketch of gate outputs (json):
```json
{"artifact_hash":"abc123","ops_ok":true,"p95_ms":78,"throughput_rps":150,"kl_delta":0.003}
```

maria: need human review step for major-quality drops even if metrics pass. business owners should confirm.

onboard-bot: checklist updated: artifact schema, ops-compat, quant-check, perf-bench, quality-check, canary-deploy.

devin: implementation note: run perf-bench in a reproducible docker + pinned driver; store artifacts in S3 with provenance.

cheng: test datasets: small canonical set (~50 prompts) + heavy tail sample (~1000) for throughput sim.

alex: next action: i'll PR a gate runner + CLI that outputs the JSON above and posts status to the thread. assign reviewers? @maria @devin

maria: happy to review gate API and UI bits. :thumbsup:

devin: will review infra + runtime checks. I'll add the compatibility matrix template to the repo.

alex: thanks — I'll open PR today and link the RFC.
